imagegen.cutoutPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied museum photograph of the 1999 gold Omega De Ville watch. Remove ONLY the plain white background, including the white holes between watch lugs and strap. Output a genuine transparent-background cutout. Preserve exact original watch position, orientation, proportions, dial text, markers, hands, date, case, crown and brown strap. Do not stylize, beautify or reconstruct anything; no additional shadow. Keep the same full 799 by 576 canvas framing, watch centered as in original. All original watch pixels should remain unchanged.
imagegen.heroPrompt: Use case: compositing. Create a restrained editorial hero photo montage for a serious independent watch magazine about George Daniels and the Co-Axial escapement. Landscape 3:2. The three provided images are original content to arrange, NOT inspiration to invent new people or parts: image 1 is the actual George Daniels at his workbench, image 2 is Omega's actual exploded escapement illustration, image 3 is his original patent drawing. Preserve their actual photographic content and identity. Left: framed documentary image 1 at sensible small scale, do not synthesize missing face detail. Right: large overlapping image 2 as dominant technical motif, all wheel teeth and mechanical parts unchanged. Patent drawing as quiet smaller lower left inset, retain original strokes. Dark forest green #232921 background, off-white #f2f0e8 hairline rules, very restrained accent #d7eb96. Clean editorial spacing, original images overlap with elegant soft transitions, no busy scrapbook. Typography top left: 'GEORGE DANIELS' and smaller 'CO-AXIAL'. Only those two labels. No imaginary watch, no decorative extra gears, no new face, no gold haze, no new schematic. This must look like an editorial layout made from original documentary material, not an AI illustration.
imagegen.finalDecision: Generated fine details were not used. Owner's original-pixel rule applied through deterministic masks and native SVG composition. Final assets live in sources and assets within this local review directory.
